spec.rawSql:
select
  marketprice / 1000.0 as price_0, start_timestamp
from data_spotdata where 
   end_timestamp at time zone 'utc' > $__timeTo() 
   order by start_timestamp
   limit 1;

select
  marketprice / 1000.0 as price_1, start_timestamp
from data_spotdata where 
   end_timestamp at time zone 'utc' > $__timeTo() 
   order by start_timestamp
   offset 1 limit 1;

select
  marketprice / 1000.0 as price_2, start_timestamp
from data_spotdata where 
   end_timestamp at time zone 'utc' > $__timeTo() 
   order by start_timestamp
   offset 2 limit 1;

SELECT start_timestamp as time, marketprice / 1000.0 as marketprice_kwh FROM data_spotdata where 
(start_timestamp + '2h'::interval) >= $__timeFrom()

select time, house_kw as "House", grid_kw as "Grid", pv_kw as "PV",
       battery_kw as "Battery", goe_kw as "Car charger",
       battery_soc as "Battery SOC"
from data_power_live
where $__timeFilter(time)
order by time;

spec.description: House consumption and where it comes from, per 15 s. Grid positive = from the grid, battery positive = charging. Near-live from the collector's live power monitor (data_power_live): read every 5 s from the inverter's power meter, averaged per 15 s, written every 30 s, so up to about 45 s behind.
spec.title: House power

spec.rawSql:
-- One row for the flow picture: the newest 15 s row of data_power_live.
-- The car's power is split by priority, not proportionally: PV covers the
-- household first, then battery charging; only the PV surplus goes to the
-- go-e. The rest comes from battery discharge (after the household), then
-- from the grid. Household = house_kw - goe_kw (house_kw includes the car).
with l as (
  select * from data_power_live order by time desc limit 1
), v as (
  select time,
         coalesce(pv_kw, 0) as pv,
         coalesce(grid_kw, 0) as grid,
         coalesce(battery_kw, 0) as bat,
         battery_soc as bat_soc,
         greatest(coalesce(house_kw, 0) - coalesce(goe_kw, 0), 0) as home,
         coalesce(goe_kw, 0) as goe
  from l
), s as (
  select v.*,
         least(goe, greatest(pv - home - greatest(bat, 0), 0)) as goe_pv
  from v
), s2 as (
  select s.*,
         least(goe - goe_pv,
               greatest(greatest(-bat, 0) - greatest(home - pv, 0), 0)) as goe_bat
  from s
), f as (
  select s2.*, greatest(goe - goe_pv - goe_bat, 0) as goe_grid,
         (select level from data_vehicle_energy_level order by time desc limit 1) as car_soc
  from s2
)
select
  to_char(time at time zone 'Europe/Vienna', 'HH24:MI:SS') as updated,
  case when time < now() - interval '2 minutes' then 'stale' else '' end as stale,
  to_char(pv, 'FM990.0') as pv_txt,
  to_char(abs(grid), 'FM990.0') as grid_txt,
  case when grid >= 0.05 then 'Import' when grid <= -0.05 then 'Export' else 'Grid' end as grid_name,
  to_char(abs(bat), 'FM990.0') as bat_txt,
  coalesce(round(bat_soc)::text || ' %', '–') as bat_soc_txt,
  to_char(home, 'FM990.0') as home_txt,
  to_char(goe, 'FM990.0') as goe_txt,
  coalesce(round(car_soc)::text || ' %', '–') as car_soc_txt,
  to_char(goe_pv, 'FM990.0') as goe_pv_txt,
  to_char(goe_bat, 'FM990.0') as goe_bat_txt,
  to_char(goe_grid, 'FM990.0') as goe_grid_txt,
  -- line state: off when the value shows as 0.0 kW (below 50 W); fwd = along the drawn path, rev = against it
  case when pv >= 0.05 then 'on fwd' else 'off' end as pv_cls,
  case when grid >= 0.05 then 'on fwd' when grid <= -0.05 then 'on rev' else 'off' end as grid_cls,
  case when bat <= -0.05 then 'on fwd' when bat >= 0.05 then 'on rev' else 'off' end as bat_cls,
  case when home >= 0.05 then 'on fwd' else 'off' end as home_cls,
  case when goe >= 0.05 then 'on fwd' else 'off' end as goe_cls,
  case when goe >= 0.05 then '' else 'off' end as split_cls,
  -- line width class by power: < 1, < 3, < 5, < 8, >= 8 kW
  case when pv < 1 then 'w1' when pv < 3 then 'w2' when pv < 5 then 'w3' when pv < 8 then 'w4' else 'w5' end as pv_w,
  case when abs(grid) < 1 then 'w1' when abs(grid) < 3 then 'w2' when abs(grid) < 5 then 'w3' when abs(grid) < 8 then 'w4' else 'w5' end as grid_w,
  case when abs(bat) < 1 then 'w1' when abs(bat) < 3 then 'w2' when abs(bat) < 5 then 'w3' when abs(bat) < 8 then 'w4' else 'w5' end as bat_w,
  case when home < 1 then 'w1' when home < 3 then 'w2' when home < 5 then 'w3' when home < 8 then 'w4' else 'w5' end as home_w,
  case when goe < 1 then 'w1' when goe < 3 then 'w2' when goe < 5 then 'w3' when goe < 8 then 'w4' else 'w5' end as goe_w,
  -- the split bar under the wallbox, in percent
  coalesce(round((100 * goe_pv / nullif(goe, 0))::numeric, 1), 0) as bar_pv,
  coalesce(round((100 * goe_bat / nullif(goe, 0))::numeric, 1), 0) as bar_bat,
  coalesce(round((100 * goe_grid / nullif(goe, 0))::numeric, 1), 0) as bar_grid
from f;

spec.description: Live power from data_power_live (one row per 15 s), with the time of the row at the top; faded when it is older than 2 minutes. Moving dots show the direction, thicker lines carry more power, grey lines and nodes show 0.0 kW (below 50 W). Household is the house without the car (house_kw − goe_kw). The bar under the wallbox shows where the car's power comes from, by priority: PV covers the household and battery charging first, only the surplus goes to the car; the rest comes from battery discharge, then the grid. Car SOC from data_vehicle_energy_level.
spec.title: Energy flow

spec.rawSql:
-- Consumption since midnight: 5-minute averages of house_kw (kW) / 12 = kWh,
-- summed up over the day.
with b as (
  select time_bucket('5 minutes', time) as time, avg(house_kw) / 12 as kwh
  from data_power_live
  where $__timeFilter(time)
  group by 1
)
select time, sum(kwh) over (order by time) as "Consumption"
from b
order by time;

spec.description: House consumption since midnight including the car, from data_power_live (5-minute averages).
spec.title: Today consumption

spec.rawSql:
-- Car since midnight: 5-minute averages of goe_kw (kW) / 12 = kWh,
-- summed up over the day.
with b as (
  select time_bucket('5 minutes', time) as time, avg(goe_kw) / 12 as kwh
  from data_power_live
  where $__timeFilter(time)
  group by 1
)
select time, sum(kwh) over (order by time) as "Car"
from b
order by time;

spec.description: Energy the wallbox delivered since midnight, from data_power_live (5-minute averages).
spec.title: Today car

spec.rawSql:
-- energy is the inverter's lifetime counter (kWh). Production since the start
-- of the range = running max (ignores dips, like data_solar_energy_cleaned)
-- minus the last counter before the range, or the first one in it.
select time,
       max(energy) over (order by time) - coalesce(
         (select max(energy) from data_solar_energy
          where time < $__timeFrom() and time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '7 days'),
         first_value(energy) over (order by time)) as energy
from data_solar_energy
where $__timeFilter(time)
order by time;

spec.description: Production since midnight from the inverter's lifetime counter (data_solar_energy), updated every 5 minutes.
spec.title: Today production
